bullets.text: Tim Cook's Royal Dinner - **Apple** CEO joins tech elite at Windsor Castle with **Trump** and other leaders.
Apple Music Import Tool - Now available globally, simplifying transitions from **Spotify** and other platforms.
iPhone Air Review - **Apple**'s thinnest iPhone ever, balancing design and functionality.
iPhone 17 Pro Performance - New model elevates capabilities with advanced design and features.
Apple Wallet Upgrade - New feature allows full credit card details storage in **iOS 26**.
AirPods Pro 3 Launch - New features exclusive to **iPhone 17** and **Air** enhance user experience.
Apple Watch Ultra 3 - First model with satellite connectivity for emergency services without cellular.
Meta's Smart Glasses - **Meta** unveils Ray-Ban Display with wristband control and enhanced features.
Nvidia Rival Groq's Success - **Groq** raises $750 million, challenging **Nvidia** in AI chip market.
Keplar's AI Market Research - New startup leverages voice AI to revolutionize traditional market research.
